question: Does the one public logQ split preserve a useful alternative and give a useful causally weighted SOC/Q point by the inherited 900 s timely-learning gate?
decision_boundary: Keep or reject this exact two-component mechanism for further qualification. No candidate promotion or coverage conclusion follows this comparison.

case.intervals: Use original dt/current/voltage values in original order. No thinning, resampling, resets or seeded fitted state.

arms.name: coincident_control
arms.initialization: Both components exactly equal the inherited public single Gaussian, each weight 1/2. Same packed kernel, wrapper, gain remedy, memory and query conventions as split arm.

arms.name: public_logQ_split
arms.initialization: Exactly the frozen half-Gaussian moment rule in the design; no cell-specific choice.

limits.interpretation: The reference itself was unresolved at 900 s. Failure rejects this proposed timely-learning mechanism, not physical identifiability or every possible bounded representation. Do not extend to 1800/2100 s after seeing the outcome.

before_primary: Freeze source revision and binary/source hashes, exact commands, compiler/math flags, plan hash and complete owned-object accounting.

Check packed full-factor arithmetic against dense covariance on fixed finite fixtures, including rank deficiency, zero residual, component gain limits and the prior minimal boundary witness. Same actual gain in mean/full Joseph.

Check two coincident components produce equal points/factors/weights and do not halve covariance or double evidence counts; check the initial split recovers public log-state moments within declared floating tolerance.

Check duplicate/order/source rejection, missing voltage, one-component failure and whole-bank prediction retention, all-zero byte preservation, ACCEPTED_RECOVERY ledger, and log-weight underflow/nonfinite behavior with tiny deterministic fixtures.

Check one-component all-zero gain, two all-zero gains with relative weight learning, all-zero with equal scores/unchanged relative weights, and rejected voltage: distinct conditional and bank evidence cursors/availability follow the frozen rules without counting extra samples.

Check complete new-format warm restore byte-equivalence on a short deterministic stream, corrupt/truncated/wrong-format atomic rejection, and cold reset with explicit history loss. Do not repeat the completed cell lifecycle primary.

Record layout and reviewed call-chain work/storage. Target 35 Hz and complete SRAM gates remain separately unqualified until actual Cortex-M23 measurements; no omitted target cost can be described as passed.

observation_and_reporting.model_supports_noise: Inherited production public model, bounds, OCV, exact-current/time benchmark and noise unchanged; public prior density approximation is the explicit arm difference.
observation_and_reporting.query_payload: Aggregate and each component point, local SD/ranges, all-component local hull, log weights, pre-correction innovation/variance, gain/numerical counters, shared ledger and application qualification.
observation_and_reporting.score_capture: Stream per-sample component pre-correction log scores/log weights to a hashed host artifact if needed for weight-path diagnosis; no retained target history or inference feedback. Summaries read fixed checkpoints first.
observation_and_reporting.truth_boundary: Inference processes receive only dt/current/voltage and public config. Freeze outputs before the separate scorer opens truth. No true hidden state at initialization, reset, correction, weighting or tuning.
observation_and_reporting.scoring: Score fixed aggregate point and each component after inference. Report oracle-best component only as an analysis of representation versus weighting, never as runtime selection. Preserve raw local precision qualification failures even when application labels are unresolved.

keep_gates.functional_and_evidence_gates: All targeted algebra, exactly-once, duplicate-control, transaction and persistence checks pass; component or mixture covariance never treated as hard support.
keep_gates.resource_gate: Owned layout fits the frozen design; measured/unknown costs are reported separately. A known excess over a reserve or 10240 B fails. Unmeasured target timing/stack is an open embedded gate, not a fabricated pass.
keep_gates.comparison_gate: Report both arms and change versus coincident control. If both pass, credit no split-specific improvement without a declared discriminating difference; record mechanism attribution unresolved. No post-result score threshold.
keep_gates.coverage_gate: Unvalidated throughout this test. Available point success is necessary for retaining this candidate, never sufficient for application qualification.

failure_interpretation: Neither component useful: this initial two-component representation did not carry an adequate alternative.
Useful component but aggregate fails: causal approximate weighting/point convention did not provide a useful output.
Both components converge to the same wrong narrow belief: common local approximation bias remains undetected.
Only relabeling, wider diagnostic ranges or withheld points improves reported status: no point-accuracy success.
Numerical/accounting/resource invariant fails: reject the implementation; preserve first output and diagnose only the concrete failed gate.
stop: One frozen two-arm prefix comparison, then keep/reject/attribution-unresolved with the missing datum named. No alternative split, pruning policy, count, horizon, noise or prior sweep after results. Preserve both original bounded candidates and every failed gate.
